# ponte_spend_budget (Resource)

A monthly model-spend budget on a scope. org (ref *), team (the agents' team label), owner (user:<ref> or group:<ref>), agent (an agent id), model (provider/model, model, or a prefix ending in *). At least one limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ponte_spend_budget" "claims_team" {
  scope       = "team"
  ref         = "claims"
  monthly_usd = 500
}

resource "ponte_spend_budget" "org" {
  scope          = "org"
  monthly_tokens = 50000000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) org, team, owner, agent or model.

### Optional

- `monthly_tokens` (Number)
- `monthly_usd` (Number)
- `ref` (String) What the scope names. Omitted for scope org; required for every other scope.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) scope:ref

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ponte_spend_budget.claims_team team:claims
```
